name: The Soul
overview: Scripture reveals that the soul is the essential life given by God when He breathes life into man, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). The soul is precious and belongs to God, who holds it accountable for sin and pronounces death upon the soul that sins (Ezekiel 18:4). While the body can be killed by others, the soul's ultimate destiny is under God's authority, who alone can destroy both soul and body in hell (Matthew 10:28). The soul's eternal significance is highlighted by the call to save souls from death through repentance and conversion (James 5:20), and at death, the spirit returns to God who gave it, while the body returns to dust (Ecclesiastes 12:7).
